name: WYSLLORA
source:
A cosy visual novel about a bunny girl and her newfound friend as she figures things out on her first day in the world she finds herself in.

[From [url=https://team-wyryrna.itch.io/wysllora]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部温馨惬意的视觉小说，讲述一名兔耳少女在新结识的朋友陪伴下，在自己初来乍到的这个陌生世界里度过第一天、一点点摸清周遭一切的故事。

[摘自[url=https://team-wyryrna.itch.io/wysllora]itch.io[/url]]
